items.title: 7.3 Kimiyai reaction ki rate par asar karne wale awamil (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 7.3, printed page 150.

blocks.text: Reactants ke kharch hone aur products ke banne ki raftarein bohat mukhtalif hoti hain, aur ek hi reactants ki reaction bhi mukhtalif halaat mein mukhtalif rates rakh sakti hai. Reaction ki rate par asar karne wale awamil reactants ki concentrations, system ka darja hararat, surface area, aur catalyst hain.

blocks.caption: Chaar awamil
rows: React karne wale zarraat ke darmiyan zyada collisions
Barhti hai, har 10 degrees C par taqreeban dugni
Tez, zyada energy wale collisions; zyada molecules Ea se oopar
Solid ke area ke saath barhti hai
Collision ke liye zyada zarraat saamne
Kam activation energy wala naya rasta

blocks.prompt: Lakri khalis oxygen mein hawa se tez kyun jalti hai, aur lakri ke chhilke kunde se tez kyun jalte hain?
blocks.explanation: Hawa sirf taqreeban panchwan hissa oxygen hai; khalis oxygen react karne wali gas ki zyada concentration hai, to fuel se collisions zyada hote hain aur reaction tez. Chhilke usi mass ke kunde se kahin bara lakri ka surface area oxygen ke saamne rakhte hain, to ek saath kahin zyada collisions ho sakte hain.

items: Rate concentration, darja hararat, surface area aur catalysts par munhasir hai; har ek 7.3.1 se 7.3.3 mein bayan hai.
